integrity: Analytical proof with complete signed orbit lifting and exact finite independent branch enumeration; no external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact orbit/zeta laws hold for 0<a<=4; ergodic density classification is only asserted at a=4 and among absolutely continuous invariant probability measures, not all measures. General two-point skew-product theory and tent-map conjugacy precede this result. Exact enumeration checks only finitely many periods. An equivalent historical treatment might exist.
title: All-period orbit lifting and two distinct chaotic statistical phases of a switched logistic map
